messages:
Ivy (Hiring): Samir accepted. He's on STEM OPT that ends Jun 20 and H-1B cap-sub transfer is pending. Wants to start Jun 1 and be on payroll. Can we do that?
Keiko (People Ops): Short: we cannot put him on US payroll if OPT lapses before authorization. If his EAD is valid on start, ok. If not, need EOR/contractor or delay. Also I-9 rules apply.
Samir (Candidate): My lawyer says transfer receipt may give work authorization in some cases? Not sure. I can start remote if needed.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Clarifying: STEM OPT gives work auth until the EAD expiry. If H-1B transfer is filed and receipt alone does not provide automatic work authorization unless its cap-exempt change of status? Receipt notice for change of status can be complex. Don't rely on receipt to work. Best options: (1) start on payroll if EAD valid on Jun 1, (2) EOR for interim, (3) unpaid onboarding/volunteer tasks (limited), or (4) contractor (tax risk). We'll draft advisory for Samir.
Ben (Payroll): Practically: if EAD valid on start and we verify I-9, payroll is fine. If not, we can't run payroll. Retro pay after authorization possible but requires HR/legal sign-off and documentation. EOR would let him be paid now but benefits differ.
Nadia (Recruiter): Samir, do you expect EAD card in hand before Jun 1? If not, are you open to EOR for 4-6 weeks?
Samir (Candidate): EAD expires Jun 20. Transfer filed May 25. I likely won't have H-1B before then. I can be EOR for a month if Redwood covers part of fees.
Keiko (People Ops): Proposed plan: we verify EAD status now. If EAD covers Jun 1 we onboard to US payroll. If not, offer short EOR (company-paid first 30 days) or unpaid ramp access. Priya will post a one-page advisory on risks. Ben: please confirm payroll cutoff and retro-pay process.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Will post advisory and sample language for offer addendum about contingent payroll on valid authorization. Also include counsel contact for CBP/USCIS questions.
visa-bot: Tagging candidate file: "stem-opt-bridge-plan" and reminder set: verify EAD 10 days before expiry.
Ben (Payroll): Payroll cutoff note: need bank + W-4 and I-9 by cutoff (5 days before pay run). Retro pay requires documented authorization date.
Ivy (Hiring): Thanks everyone. Samir, please upload EAD images and keep us posted. We'll aim to keep you engaged whichever path you pick.
